title: Isabel made our Seville Bullring tour unforgettable
text:
We toured the Real Maestranza today with Isabel, and she was outstanding. She clearly knows this place inside out, from the bullring's centuries of history and its architecture to the traditions and rituals that still shape every corrida. She answered every question with confidence and often added extra detail we'd never have thought to ask about.

What stood out most was how much fascinating information she shared without it ever feeling like a lecture. She told stories about famous matadors, the meaning behind the costumes and ceremonies and she kept us hooked from beginning to end.

title: Highly recommend
text: Isabel was not only incredibly thoughtful, but also wonderfully knowledgeable. She was very patient, and had a beautiful demeanour, making the entire experience memorable.  She also went out of her way to recommend other experiences to ensure we saw all that Seville had to offer.  Highly recommend.

title: A great personal tour of bullring and museum
text: Isabel was a good and knowledgeable tour guide. She knew so much history about Seville and bullfighting. It was very nice to have a personal tour so we could have explanation of the museum and bullring. She even brought us a little gift of local treats and had recommendations to continue our wonderful visit in Seville.

title: Insightful tour and charming tour guide
text: We loved our tour with Isabel! She is so knowledgeable and fun to be around! We learned so much about the history of Spanish bullfighting and the culture and traditions surrounding the sport.
